spells.name: Grasping Vines
spells.base_description: Weeds and vines burst from the ground, coiling around anything nearby.

spells.name: Honeyed Urging
spells.base_description: Your words plant an idea that seems entirely reasonable to the listener.

spells.name: Timefreeze
spells.base_description: Time stops for all but you.

spells.name: Cast Out
spells.base_description: You travel through or call forth folded starlit space. the rift hums loudly

spells.name: Whirlpool
spells.base_description: Bonds of rushing water lock a creature in place. needs water nearby

spells.name: Trap Circle
spells.base_description: Bonds of pale soul-light lock a creature in place. shaken by strong emotion

spells.name: Sleep Glyph
spells.base_description: Bonds of pale soul-light lock a creature in place. shaken by strong emotion

spells.name: Force Grip
spells.base_description: Bonds of blazing starlight lock a creature in place. weak in darkness

spells.name: Muscle Lock
spells.base_description: You cramp a creature's muscles so it can't move. you must touch them

spells.name: Nerve Pinch
spells.base_description: A pinch on a nerve freezes a limb. only on the living

spells.name: Rot Grip
spells.base_description: Rotting hands burst from the ground and hold a creature. the ground is left dead

spells.name: Static Grip
spells.base_description: A charge locks a foe's muscles in place. metal armor protects them

spells.name: Lightning Cage
spells.base_description: Bars of lightning trap a creature. it shocks you if you get near

spells.name: Water Bubble
spells.base_description: A floating sphere of water traps a creature inside. it can drown if you don't release it

spells.name: Stuck Moment
spells.base_description: You freeze a creature in a single repeating second. you must keep your eyes on it

spells.name: Slow Field
spells.base_description: Arrows and blades crawl through the air around you. you move slowly inside it too

spells.name: Timelock
spells.base_description: A door or chest is locked in a moment no one can open. you can't open it either until it ends

spells.name: Heart Grip
spells.base_description: You squeeze a creature's heart from afar and it freezes. you feel every beat it struggles

spells.name: Numbing Bite
spells.base_description: A dose of paralytic venom stiffens a creature's limbs. poison-immune creatures ignore it

spells.name: Spider Silk
spells.base_description: Sticky, toxic threads lash a creature in place. the silk stings you as you spin it

spells.name: Deadlock Toxin
spells.base_description: A powerful venom freezes every muscle in the body. you must stay close enough to touch

spells.name: Abyssal Grasp
spells.base_description: Writhing black tendrils rise to clutch and crush.

spells.name: Mindbind
spells.base_description: You seize control of a humanoid's mind.

spells.name: Stoneflesh
spells.base_description: A creature's flesh slowly hardens into stone.

spells.name: Crowd Urging
spells.base_description: Your words plant ideas in many minds at once.

spells.name: Will Seize
spells.base_description: You seize control of any creature's mind.

spells.name: Labyrinth
spells.base_description: A creature is lost in a twisting maze.

spells.name: Stunning Utterance
spells.base_description: A single word stuns a creature.

spells.name: Eternal Prison
spells.base_description: A creature is bound in an eternal prison.

spells.name: Warm Regard
spells.base_description: A creature suddenly sees you as a trusted friend, at least for a while.

spells.name: Body Lock
spells.base_description: A humanoid freezes in place, its muscles locked by your magic.

spells.name: Beastbind
spells.base_description: You seize control of a beast's mind.

spells.name: Halt
spells.base_description: Bonds of pale soul-light lock a creature in place. shaken by strong emotion

spells.name: Prism Cage
spells.base_description: An invisible cage of force traps a creature.

spells.name: Grovel
spells.base_description: You mark a foe with pale soul-light that clings and gnaws. shaken by strong emotion

spells.name: Compel Dance
spells.base_description: A creature dances wildly, unable to stop.

spells.name: Dreadweave
spells.base_description: Nightmare illusions stalk many minds at once.

spells.name: Terror Wave
spells.base_description: A wave of dread sends creatures fleeing in panic.

spells.name: Knuckle Crack
spells.base_description: Melee spell attack: 1d10 bludgeoning, and an object or barrier you hit takes double. 2d10 at 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17.

spells.name: Frozen Moment
spells.base_description: You freeze a moment in time around a creature. It must make a Judgment roll or be paralyzed, unable to move or act.

spells.name: Frostcut Pebble
spells.base_description: Make a fist-sized stone or ice tool (wedge, hook, key blank) that lasts until your next long rest.

spells.name: Starmend
spells.base_description: A creature regains 1 HP, or a dying creature becomes stable. Once per creature per short rest.

spells.name: Shadow Double
spells.base_description: A shadowy copy of you shimmers for 1 round; the next attack against you has disadvantage.

spells.name: Hearthstone
spells.base_description: Casting time 1 minute. Make a palm-sized stone that stays warm (or burns with a candle flame) for 8 hours.

spells.name: Infernal Mandate
spells.base_description: A 30-ft aura around you for 10 rounds (1 minute). Allies in the aura (you included) add +1d6 fire to weapon hits, have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed, and gain resistance to fire. Enemies that start their turn in the aura take 2d6 fire (no save). The spell ends early if you drop to 0 HP.

spells.name: Iron Pulse
spells.base_description: Body Magic. Your next weapon hit before the spell ends (1 round) deals +1d4 damage of the weapon's type (1d6 at L11, 1d8 at L17). No attack or save.

spells.name: War Trance
spells.base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. You gain temporary HP equal to 2d10 + your level and can't be frightened for 10 rounds (1 minute). Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, you can reroll it.

spells.name: Spirit Latch
spells.base_description: Seal a door, box or window for 1 hour; spirits can't pass it, and opening it takes a DC 12 Presence check.

spells.name: Soulmirage
spells.base_description: A faint, ghostly image of a creature or object up to 5 ft for 1 minute; it can't make sound. Knowledge against your DC reveals it.

spells.name: Whisper Wind
spells.base_description: Create a sound or a puff of shaped mist up to a 5-ft cube for 1 minute; a Knowledge check against your spell DC reveals it.

spells.name: Gloomrot
spells.base_description: One creature makes a Judgment roll or takes 1d6 necrotic and has -1d4 on its next attack (2d6 at 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17).

spells.name: Bend Water
spells.base_description: Choose water you can see in an area up to a 5-ft cube (10 rounds / 1 hour). Move it up to 5 ft or change its flow; shape it into simple forms that hold; make it clear or cloudy; or freeze or thaw it if no bigger than a 1-ft cube. Up to two effects at once. Area: 10-ft cube at 5, 15-ft at 11, 20-ft at 17.

spells.name: Frost Punch
spells.base_description: Melee spell attack: 1d8 cold. 2d8 at 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17. (Provisional: mirrors Spark Grip until the handbook sets its mechanics.)

spells.name: Ember Spark
spells.base_description: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object. On a hit it takes 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object that isn't worn or carried catches fire. 2d10 at 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17.

spells.name: Grit Spit
spells.base_description: Make a ranged spell attack: 1d8 bludgeoning. 2d8 at 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.

spells.name: Soulbrand
spells.base_description: Reaver signature cantrip. You brand one creature you can see within 60 ft (10 rounds in combat, 1 hour out of combat; no attack or save to place). The first time you hit it with a weapon attack on each of your turns, it takes an extra 1d6 necrotic (1d8 at L5, 1d10 at L11, 2d6 at L17). You have advantage on checks to track or find it. If it drops to 0 HP before the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a later turn to move the brand to a new creature you can see within 60 ft. Only one brand at a time; casting it again ends the old one. When you place or move the brand, choose one. Weaken: the branded creature subtracts 1d4 from its first attack roll each turn against anyone but you. Strengthen: you gain temporary HP equal to your Confidence modifier (minimum 1) each time the extra damage triggers.

spells.name: Vein Snare
spells.base_description: One creature you can see makes a Endurance roll. On a failure it takes 1d4 necrotic and its speed drops by 10 ft until the end of its next turn; on a success nothing happens. Creatures without blood are immune. 2d4 at 5, 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17.

spells.name: Breath Iron
spells.base_description: Self or one willing creature you touch (10 rounds / 10 minutes) adds +1d4 to its next Might or Endurance check or Endurance roll, and can hold its breath 10 times as long. Ends once the die is used. Once per creature per short rest. Die: 1d6 at 5, 1d8 at 11, 1d10 at 17.

spells.name: Pact Vigor
spells.base_description: You and up to 2 allies within 30 ft each gain temporary HP equal to 2d8 + your Confidence modifier and add +1d4 to weapon damage rolls for 10 rounds (1 minute). No attack or save. Upcast: +1d8 temporary HP per slot level above 4th.

spells.name: Limb Wither
spells.base_description: Body Magic. Endurance roll. On a failed save the target takes 1d6 necrotic (2d6 at L5, 3d6 at L11, 4d6 at L17) and has -1d4 on its next weapon damage roll before the end of its next turn. On a success, nothing happens.

spells.name: Hobbling Strike
spells.base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. Bonus action after you hit a creature with a weapon. For 10 rounds (1 minute) its speed is halved and it can't take reactions. It makes a Endurance roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Body Magic doesn't upcast.

spells.name: Unstrung
spells.base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. 60 ft. Endurance roll. On a failure the target takes 3d8 necrotic and for 10 rounds (1 minute) has disadvantage on Might and Precision checks and saves and deals half damage with weapon attacks; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success. On a successful initial save it takes half damage and suffers no other effect.

spells.name: Ironbrawn
spells.base_description: Body Magic, once per long rest. For 10 rounds (1 minute) you grow one size if there's room, gain advantage on Might checks and saves, your weapon hits deal +1d6, and your reach grows by 5 ft. No attack or save.

spells.name: Painecho
spells.base_description: You force a creature to relive its oldest wound. It must make a Judgment roll, taking psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Static Bloom
spells.base_description: A burst of sparks blooms at a point you choose. Each creature nearby must make a Precision roll or take lightning damage.

spells.name: Razorwind
spells.base_description: A blade-sharp sheet of wind sweeps across an area. Each creature in it must make a Precision roll, taking slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Hourglass Prison
spells.base_description: You trap a creature in a prison of slowed time. It must make a Judgment roll or be stuck, barely able to move or act.

spells.name: Soulswap
spells.base_description: You rip two creatures' souls out of their bodies and swap them. Each must make a Confidence roll or wake up trapped in the other's body.

spells.name: Bonegarden
spells.base_description: Skeletal hands burst out of the ground in an area and drag at your foes. Each creature in the area must make a Endurance roll, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Deathless Vigor
spells.base_description: Necromantic power bolsters you with a borrowed, hollow vitality.

spells.name: Cloudwalk
spells.base_description: Creatures turn to cloud and ride the winds.

spells.name: Spiritwalk
spells.base_description: You step into the spirit realm, unseen by the living.

spells.name: Compelling Pull
spells.base_description: Creatures are compelled to move where you will them.

spells.name: Soul Vessel
spells.base_description: Your soul leaves your body and dwells in an object.

spells.name: Homecall
spells.base_description: You and your allies instantly return to a sacred place.

spells.name: Heartwish
spells.base_description: Your deepest wish reshapes reality itself.

spells.name: Howling Screen
spells.base_description: A wall of howling wind deflects arrows and gusts.

spells.name: Coral Shield
spells.base_description: You grow a shield of hard coral. it dries and crumbles out of water

spells.name: Afterimage
spells.base_description: You leave copies of yourself a second behind. they copy only your last move

spells.name: Future Glimpse
spells.base_description: A foe sees a false vision of what you'll do next. you must do something else

spells.name: Echo Self
spells.base_description: A copy of you from a moment ago fights beside you. it fades in seconds

spells.name: Recall Object
spells.base_description: An object you held earlier today returns to your hand. it vanishes from wherever it was

spells.name: Exile
spells.base_description: A creature vanishes to a distant plane, banished from your sight.

spells.name: Sticky Weave
spells.base_description: Thick, sticky webs fill an area, ensnaring anything caught inside.

spells.name: Past Army
spells.base_description: Soldiers who once fought here return for one battle. they fight for whoever once owned the land

spells.name: Haste Time
spells.base_description: Time speeds up around a plant, food or wound. it also rots or ages faster

spells.name: Restore Ruin
spells.base_description: A broken thing returns to how it was before it broke. only if it broke today

spells.name: Sundial Mark
spells.base_description: A small mark always shows you the true time. it glows faintly

spells.name: Hour Vault
spells.base_description: You build a room where time stands still. you age normally while inside

spells.name: Draw Poison
spells.base_description: You pull poison out of a wound into your own palm. you take a little of it yourself

spells.name: Stillpocket
spells.base_description: A pocket of stopped time no blow can cross. you can’t act out of it either

spells.name: Riptide Pull
spells.base_description: A current drags a creature down and holds it there. only works in water

spells.name: Tempo Shift
spells.base_description: You bend time around a creature, either speeding up an ally or slowing down a foe. An unwilling target makes a Judgment roll to resist.

spells.name: Grace Bolt
spells.base_description: Wraith only. Evocation cantrip; 1 action; range 60 ft; components V, S. A chain of radiant light lashes out. Make a ranged spell attack (proficiency + Intellect). On a hit, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage (don't add Intellect to damage). Beams: 1 at levels 1-4, 2 at 5-10, 3 at 11-16, 4 at 17-30. Each beam is a separate attack roll; aim them at the same target or different ones. Once per turn, when a beam hits a Large or smaller creature, you can pull it up to 5 ft toward you. Counts toward your cantrip limit.

spells.name: Taint Water
spells.base_description: You turn water or drink foul with a touch. you can't undo it

spells.name: Fume Steer
spells.base_description: You guide a cloud of toxic vapor with your hand. a strong wind takes it from you

spells.name: Hallucinate
spells.base_description: A small, silent illusion shimmers into being, real enough to fool a passing glance.

spells.name: Bend Stone
spells.base_description: Under your palms, solid stone softens like clay and takes whatever form you press into it.

spells.name: Wildsign
spells.base_description: You read the wind for weather, coax a bud to bloom, or stir the leaves with a whisper of the wild.

spells.name: Omen Sign
spells.base_description: The ground trembles, flames flicker, and your voice booms with the weight of the heavens.

spells.name: Shimmerblur
spells.base_description: Your form wavers and blurs, making you hard to strike.

spells.name: Prey Brand
spells.base_description: You mark your prey with a hunter's magic, sensing its every move.

spells.name: Rainspoon
spells.base_description: You draw a cup of glowing rain from the air. A creature that drinks it regains a small amount of health.

spells.name: Tribunal of Souls
spells.base_description: The spirits of ancient judges stand beside your allies, protecting them from being frightened or charmed.

spells.name: Heartbeat Theft
spells.base_description: You steal a heartbeat from time and act a moment sooner, improving your place in the initiative order.

spells.name: Living Cathedral
spells.base_description: You reshape an ally's body into a fortress, greatly boosting their health and toughness.

spells.name: Unwind
spells.base_description: You rewind a moment for an ally, letting them reroll an attack, check, or save they just failed.

spells.name: Titan's Sinew
spells.base_description: An ally swells with a giant's strength, letting them lift, carry, and hit much harder.

spells.name: Babel Kiss
spells.base_description: You touch a creature's lips, letting it speak and understand every language it hears.

spells.name: Lanternmoth
spells.base_description: A moth of golden light flutters from your hands and follows you, shining like a lantern.

spells.name: Wisp of the Pale Star
spells.base_description: You call a mote of starlight that hovers where you point and lights the area around it.

spells.name: Riftwalk
spells.base_description: You tear open space and step through to any place you have seen with your own eyes.

spells.name: Door Beyond the Stars
spells.base_description: You open a doorway to another plane of existence. You and your allies can step through to any world you name.

spells.name: Skyshift
spells.base_description: You fold the air and step through it, teleporting to a spot you can see within range.

spells.name: Verdant Hand
spells.base_description: A hand of woven vines grows from the ground to fetch, carry, or pull things for you.

spells.name: Keepward
spells.base_description: Wards protect a stronghold against intruders.

spells.name: Briarchain
spells.base_description: Thorned vines lash out of the ground and wrap around a creature. It must make a Might roll or be restrained and take piercing damage from the thorns.

spells.name: Moonpull Tide
spells.base_description: You command the tides to drag a creature. It must make a Might roll or be pulled wherever you choose.

spells.name: Stillfrost Grasp
spells.base_description: Your touch encases a creature or object in hoarfrost. A creature must make a Endurance roll or be frozen in place for a moment.

spells.name: Verdant Uprising
spells.base_description: A forest erupts from the ground, and its branches grab at everything nearby. Each creature in the area must make a Might roll or be restrained.

spells.name: Grit Storm
spells.base_description: You kick up a whirling cloud of grit. Each creature inside must make a Endurance roll or be blinded.

spells.name: Mistwalk Veil
spells.base_description: A silver mist rises around you and blurs your form. Attacks against you are made at disadvantage.

spells.name: Starward Ward
spells.base_description: A lattice of starlight surrounds you. The next attack that hits you is turned aside harmlessly.

spells.name: Mountain's Root
spells.base_description: Your feet root into the ground like a mountain. Nothing can push, pull, or knock you prone.

spells.name: Starless Night
spells.base_description: You fill an area with magical, moonless darkness that ordinary light can't penetrate.

spells.name: Diamond Skin
spells.base_description: You turn an ally's skin to living diamond, making them much harder to hit and letting blades glance off.

spells.name: Nightfold
spells.base_description: You fold the shadows around an area into a pocket of silent, magical darkness.

spells.name: Loom of Silence
spells.base_description: You create a zone of total silence. No sound can be made inside it, and spells that need a voice can't be cast there.

spells.name: Breath of the Deep
spells.base_description: You fill a creature's lungs with enchanted air, letting it breathe underwater or in thick smoke.

spells.name: Glacierwall
spells.base_description: A wall of blue ice bursts from the ground, giving you cover and blocking attacks from the other side.

spells.name: Pyre Halo
spells.base_description: A halo of fire crowns an ally. Any creature that hits or grabs them takes fire damage.

spells.name: Astral Sidestep
spells.base_description: You slip half a step into the astral sea, letting an attack pass harmlessly through you.

spells.name: Inkfall Eclipse
spells.base_description: You blot out the sun over an area and fill it with liquid darkness that ordinary light can't penetrate.

spells.name: Float
spells.base_description: You make an object float weightless. it drifts in the wind

spells.name: Gale Avenue
spells.base_description: A corridor of roaring wind blasts out in a line. Each creature in the line must make a Might roll or be hurled along its path.

spells.name: Kindle Whisper
spells.base_description: You command a flame you can see to dance, flare up, or gutter out. You can also make the fire lash out and burn a creature near it.

spells.name: Echo of the Unseen
spells.base_description: You send a whisper through the air that returns to tell you what is waiting on the other side of a door or wall.

spells.name: Ashen Path
spells.base_description: You leave a trail of glowing ash footprints that only you and allies you choose can see.

spells.name: Bloodread
spells.base_description: You taste a drop of a creature's blood and learn about it: how wounded it is, what it fears, and what it last ate.

spells.name: Hearthseed
spells.base_description: You conjure a steady, smokeless flame in your palm. It gives off light and warmth and can be used to light things, but doesn't burn you.

spells.name: Greenwhisper
spells.base_description: You listen to the plants around you, and they tell you what has passed among them in the last day.

spells.name: Stormthread
spells.base_description: You catch a bolt of lightning on your fingertip and redirect it, turning an incoming lightning attack or spell toward a target you choose.

spells.name: Loom of the World
spells.base_description: You pull the threads of reality and restore a broken structure, like a bridge, wall, or ruin, as if it were new.

spells.name: Oak's Watch
spells.base_description: You touch a tree and borrow its senses, letting you see and hear everything that passes beneath its branches.

spells.name: Stonewright's Touch
spells.base_description: You soften stone with your touch so you can sculpt it with your fingers like clay.

spells.name: Bloodsight
spells.base_description: Your eyes turn crimson and you can see the heartbeat of every living creature nearby, even through walls.

spells.name: Rime Seal
spells.base_description: You breathe on a lock, jar, or door and freeze it shut under a sheet of magic ice.

spells.name: Heartsight
spells.base_description: You see every heart within range glowing through flesh, and you know how close each creature is to death.

spells.name: Soulthread
spells.base_description: You link the minds of willing allies with an astral thread so they can share thoughts telepathically.

spells.name: Bloodward
spells.base_description: You paint a ward in your own blood. It absorbs the next harmful spell aimed at you.

spells.name: Echo of Yesterday
spells.base_description: You replay the last minute of time around you like a ghostly echo, letting you see what just happened in the area.

spells.name: Sealbreaker
spells.base_description: You speak a word of unmaking that shatters magical seals, locks, and wards in front of you.

spells.name: Umbral Lance
spells.base_description: You hurl a spear of living shadow at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the shadow pierces it with frost-dark cold.

spells.name: Thunderneedle
spells.base_description: You fire a needle of lightning at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it punches through armor and deals lightning damage.

spells.name: Sunspear
spells.base_description: You call down a lance of sunlight on a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it takes radiant damage, and undead are hit especially hard.

spells.name: Flame Lash
spells.base_description: A whip of liquid fire uncoils from your hand and lashes a creature. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit, it takes fire damage.

spells.name: Glacial Dart
spells.base_description: You hurl a shard of glacier ice at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it takes cold damage.

spells.name: Starfall Barrage
spells.base_description: You pull down a storm of falling stars across the battlefield. Each creature in the area must make a Precision roll, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Phoenix Fan
spells.base_description: You sweep your arm and send out a cone of burning phoenix feathers. Each creature in the cone must make a Precision roll, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Tectonic Pulse
spells.base_description: The earth heaves and splits beneath your enemies. Each creature in the area must make a Precision roll, taking bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Wildfire Chain
spells.base_description: Fire leaps from foe to foe like a living thing. Each creature it reaches must make a Precision roll, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Skyhammer
spells.base_description: You call down a pillar of lightning on a point you choose. Each creature there must make a Precision roll, taking lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Winter's Throne
spells.base_description: You call down a raging blizzard over an area. Each creature caught in it must make a Endurance roll, taking cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

spells.name: Void Pull
spells.base_description: A foe is tugged toward an unseen rift. it tugs you too

spells.name: Steady Hands
spells.base_description: You mark an ally with your blood, steadying their arms. Their weapon attacks become more accurate.

spells.name: Venomsip
spells.base_description: You draw poison out of a creature's wound and flick it away harmlessly, ending the poison's effect.

spells.name: Ghostward Hush
spells.base_description: You quiet the restless dead around you. Spirits and undead in the area can't harm the living while the spell lasts.

spells.name: Choir of Iron
spells.base_description: You sing, and your allies' weapons ring in answer. While your song lasts, their weapon attacks deal extra damage.

spells.name: Mind Palace
spells.base_description: You build a palace of thought in your mind, sharpening your focus. The next spell you cast costs less to cast.

spells.name: Beastcalm
spells.base_description: You speak soothingly to a wild creature, and it comes to see you as a friend.

spells.name: Phoenix Rebirth
spells.base_description: Flames consume a dying ally, and they rise from the ashes healed and cured of poison and disease.

spells.name: Orbit of the Lost Moon
spells.base_description: A small moon of astral light circles you and blocks the first attack against you each round.

spells.name: Hollow Choir
spells.base_description: Ghostly voices sing from nowhere. Each enemy that hears them must make a Judgment roll or become confused and lose its way.

spells.name: Winter's Kiss
spells.base_description: You blow a kiss of winter at a creature. It must make a Endurance roll or take cold damage and have its speed reduced.

spells.name: Mirrorflash
spells.base_description: You flash conjured light from a silver mirror at a creature. It must make a Endurance roll or be blinded.

spells.name: Glare of the Sunken Eye
spells.base_description: Your eyes flash with drowned starlight at a creature that meets your gaze. It must make a Endurance roll or be blinded until your next turn.

spells.name: Hex of Whispers
spells.base_description: You whisper a curse in a dead tongue at a creature. It must make a Judgment roll or take psychic damage as the words sap its nerve.

spells.name: Emberbind
spells.base_description: Ropes of smoldering ash coil around a creature's feet. It must make a Precision roll or take fire damage and have its speed reduced.

spells.name: Groundsplit
spells.base_description: You stamp and the ground cracks open under a creature. It must make a Precision roll or take bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

spells.name: Drowned Dream

spells.base_description: Spirits swirl around you, harming foes who come near.

spells.name: Rolling Thunder
spells.base_description: You split the sky along a line, and a roll of thunder crashes down upon everything in its path.

spells.name: Sentinel Spirit
spells.base_description: A spectral guardian appears to watch over a place.

spells.name: Hailstorm
spells.base_description: Hail and ice rain down in a crushing storm.

spells.name: Fire Rampart
spells.base_description: A wall of roaring fire rises at your command.

spells.name: Death Fog
spells.base_description: A rolling, poisonous fog drifts from you to choke your foes.

spells.name: Winter Gust
spells.base_description: A blast of bitter cold erupts from your hands.

spells.name: Pillar of Flame
spells.base_description: A column of fire and radiance falls from the heavens.

spells.name: Star Mark
spells.base_description: You brand a foe with the mark of a comet, and the next strike against it calls a falling star down upon it.

spells.name: Bladestorm Wall
spells.base_description: A whirling wall of spectral blades shreds anything that passes.

spells.name: Arc Bolt
spells.base_description: Lightning leaps from foe to foe in a crackling arc.

spells.name: Frost Orb
spells.base_description: A frigid globe explodes, freezing anything it touches.

spells.name: Solar Lance
spells.base_description: A beam of brilliant sunlight blasts out from your hand.

spells.name: Rime Rampart
spells.base_description: A wall of ice rises to block your foes.

spells.name: Briar Hedge
spells.base_description: A wall of tangled thorns rises from the ground.

spells.name: Phantom Blade
spells.base_description: A shimmering spectral sword fights at your command.

spells.name: Fused Ember
spells.base_description: A bead of fire grows hotter the longer it waits.

spells.name: Blazing Tempest
spells.base_description: A raging storm of fire sweeps the area.

spells.name: Rainbow Ray
spells.base_description: Rays of many colors burst out, each with a different effect.

spells.name: Worldshake
spells.base_description: The ground heaves and splits in a mighty quake.

spells.name: Ashen Smother
spells.base_description: A cloud of burning smoke rolls across the field.

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.base_description: A blinding burst of sunlight sears all around you.

spells.name: Skyfire Rain
spells.base_description: Blazing stars fall from the sky in fiery impacts.

spells.name: Storm of the End
spells.base_description: A storm unleashes thunder, lightning, and rain.

spells.name: Rust Mist
spells.base_description: An acidic mist eats away at locks and hinges. it ruins your own gear too

spells.name: Corrode Ward
spells.base_description: Acid seeps into a magical barrier until it crumbles. slow, and it reeks

spells.name: Acid Bore
spells.base_description: Burning acid chews a tunnel through stone and steel. the fumes linger for an hour

spells.name: Unweave
spells.base_description: You unravel an ongoing spell, ending its magic.

spells.name: Spellbreak
spells.base_description: You snuff out another caster's magic in the moment it's woven.

spells.name: Blast Rune
spells.base_description: A sudden blast of folded starlit space strikes your foe. the rift hums loudly

spells.name: Force Punch
spells.base_description: A sudden blast of blazing starlight strikes your foe. weak in darkness

spells.name: Swarmcloud
spells.base_description: A buzzing, biting swarm of insects fills an area.

spells.name: Seeker Darts
spells.base_description: Glowing darts of force streak from your hand and never miss their mark.

spells.name: Pain Glyph
spells.base_description: You mark a foe with pale soul-light that clings and gnaws. shaken by strong emotion

spells.name: Heal Block
spells.base_description: You mark a foe with creeping rot that clings and gnaws. sickens you slightly

spells.name: Smolder Brand
spells.base_description: The target smolders each time it strikes. lights you both up

spells.name: Frostbite Hex
spells.base_description: Cold creeps through the target and slows it. warming ends it

spells.name: Gust Jinx
spells.base_description: The winds turn on the target’s missiles. yours veer too up close

spells.name: Stone Weight
spells.base_description: The target grows heavy as rock. you are slowed while you focus

spells.name: Lost Stars
spells.base_description: A foe loses all sense of direction. fades under open sky

spells.name: Sap Strength
spells.base_description: A foe's muscles grow weak and slack. you feel tired too

spells.name: Burning Fever
spells.base_description: A fever burns through a foe's body. fades if they're doused

spells.name: Pollen Sneeze
spells.base_description: A puff of pollen makes a foe sneeze nonstop. it may spread to allies

spells.name: Strangling Weed
spells.base_description: A weed grows inside a foe and tightens. fire cures it

spells.name: Creeping Stone
spells.base_description: A foe slowly turns to stone. the curse can be scrubbed off early

spells.name: Chill Bones
spells.base_description: Cold settles into a foe's bones and won't leave. ends near fire

spells.name: Static Cling
spells.base_description: Metal objects stick to a foe and drag them down. it clings to you as well

spells.name: Storm Doom
spells.base_description: A foe is followed by a cloud that strikes them at random. it may strike those near them

spells.name: Shaking Nerves
spells.base_description: Tingling static keeps a foe twitching. you feel faint tingles too

spells.name: Drowning Breath
spells.base_description: A foe's lungs fill with water. you feel a tightness in your own chest

spells.name: Lost Hours
spells.base_description: A foe loses track of time and keeps missing their chance. it lasts only an hour

spells.name: Withering Years
spells.base_description: A foe ages a decade in moments. you age a year

spells.name: Bleeding Mark
spells.base_description: A mark makes a foe's wounds refuse to close. you must draw their blood first

spells.name: Thin Blood
spells.base_description: A foe's blood turns watery and weak. it fades if they are healed by magic

spells.name: Beacon
spells.base_description: A tiny star falls and clings to a creature, outlining it in light so it cannot hide.

spells.name: Slow Rot
spells.base_description: A lingering poison sinks into a foe's blood and festers. it takes days to show its worst

spells.name: Barbed Jest
spells.base_description: Your words cut sharper than steel, laced with magic that stings the mind.

spells.name: Prism Burst
spells.base_description: A dazzling spray of colored light leaves those in its path reeling and blind.

spells.name: Glowmark
spells.base_description: Shimmering light outlines your foes, leaving them nowhere to hide.

spells.name: Water Mark
spells.base_description: You brand a creature with a sigil of the sea, and each turn the tide hauls it toward you.

spells.name: Senseblight
spells.base_description: You steal a creature's sight or hearing with a curse.

spells.name: Captivate
spells.base_description: Your words weave a spell that holds an audience in rapt attention.

spells.name: Hexcurse
spells.base_description: A dark curse weakens a creature in a way of your choosing.

spells.name: Mesmer Weave
spells.base_description: A twisting pattern of colors leaves watchers transfixed.

spells.name: Leaden Time
spells.base_description: Time thickens around your foes, slowing their every move.

spells.name: Deepquake
spells.base_description: A buried boom shakes the earth from below, deafening and toppling everything above it.

spells.name: Bewilder
spells.base_description: Minds twist and stumble, leaving creatures confused.

spells.name: Nightmare Shade
spells.base_description: A creature's worst fear takes shape in its mind.

spells.name: Plaguetouch
spells.base_description: Your touch spreads a vile, lingering sickness.

spells.name: Dreamwalk
spells.base_description: You walk into a creature's dreams to speak or terrify.

spells.name: Binding Oath
spells.base_description: A magical command compels a creature to perform a service.

spells.name: Hex Gaze
spells.base_description: Your eyes become dark, casting curses with each glance.

spells.name: Word of Heaven
spells.base_description: A word of divine power strikes down the unworthy.

spells.name: Mindbreak
spells.base_description: A creature's mind shatters, leaving it dull.

spells.name: Ill Fortune
spells.base_description: A pall of bad luck settles over your enemies, making every effort falter.

spells.name: Slumber Mist
spells.base_description: A drowsy haze rolls over creatures, sending them into a deep sleep.

spells.name: Giggle Curse
spells.base_description: A creature collapses in helpless laughter at a joke only it can hear.

spells.name: Death Glyph
spells.base_description: Overwhelming creeping rot unmakes whatever it touches. sickens you slightly

spells.name: Soul Sever
spells.base_description: You cut a soul loose from its body. leaves you shaken

spells.name: Hemorrhage
spells.base_description: Every wound on the target bursts open. costs you hit points too

spells.name: Lanternkiss
spells.base_description: You touch an object and it glows with a warm, steady light like a hearth lantern.

spells.name: Venom Mist
spells.base_description: A puff of sickly green vapor bursts from your palm and chokes the air around a foe.

spells.name: Soul Burn
spells.base_description: Spirit fire burns away a foe's soul. leaves you hollow

spells.name: Black Hole
spells.base_description: A tiny black hole swallows all around it. it pulls you too

spells.name: Unworld
spells.base_description: A foe is cast out of the world entirely. you may follow

spells.name: Heart Stop
spells.base_description: You stop a creature's heart with a touch. you must touch them

spells.name: Supernova
spells.base_description: You explode with the light of a dying star. it drains you fully

spells.name: Inferno
spells.base_description: A raging fire consumes everything. it spreads beyond your control

spells.name: Void Swallow
spells.base_description: A shadow swallows a foe whole. it may hunger for more

spells.name: Endless Night
spells.base_description: Darkness falls that kills what it touches. it lingers for a day

spells.name: Choke Grove
spells.base_description: A grove of vines strangles all in it. it chokes allies too

spells.name: Wild Reclaim
spells.base_description: Nature swallows a whole building or camp. can't be undone

spells.name: Earth Swallow
spells.base_description: The ground opens and closes over a foe. it leaves the land scarred

spells.name: Crushing Mountain
spells.base_description: A mountain's weight falls on your foes. you must be on rock

spells.name: Tornado
spells.base_description: A tornado tears across the land. you can't control where it goes

spells.name: Vacuum
spells.base_description: All air is ripped away from a foe. it pulls you in too

spells.name: Absolute Zero
spells.base_description: All warmth flees from a foe and they freeze solid. nearby allies freeze too

spells.name: Ice Age
spells.base_description: A wide land is buried in killing cold. it lasts for days

spells.name: Lightning Storm
spells.base_description: A fierce storm rains down bolts over a wide area. it strikes randomly

spells.name: Skyfall Bolt
spells.base_description: A single colossal bolt annihilates what it strikes. you're deafened and knocked down

spells.name: Maelstrom
spells.base_description: A huge whirlpool swallows ships and stone. it drags at you too

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.base_description: A wall of water crushes everything in its path. it can't be stopped once begun

spells.name: Drown
spells.base_description: Water pours into a foe's lungs until they stop. you must hold the spell with your breath

spells.name: Erase Past
spells.base_description: A creature is unwritten from time and was never born. you forget them too

spells.name: Dust to Dust
spells.base_description: A foe or object ages a thousand years in a breath. it works only on what you touch

spells.name: Final Hour
spells.base_description: A foe's heartbeat counts down to its last. it takes an hour to finish

spells.name: Boil Blood
spells.base_description: A foe's blood boils in their veins. you must have tasted their blood

spells.name: Exsanguinate
spells.base_description: Every drop of blood is pulled from a foe's body. you are drenched in it

spells.name: Rotting Touch
spells.base_description: Your touch spreads rot and ruin through a foe's flesh.

spells.name: Sapping Beam
spells.base_description: A dark ray saps a creature's strength, weakening its blows.

spells.name: Raise Bones
spells.base_description: Bones and corpses stir and rise to serve you.

spells.name: Leeching Grip
spells.base_description: Your touch drains life from a foe and feeds it to you.

spells.name: Blightdraw
spells.base_description: Life drains from a creature or plant, leaving it shriveled.

spells.name: Deathring
spells.base_description: A sphere of negative energy ripples outward, draining life.

spells.name: Raise Unliving
spells.base_description: Corpses rise as strong, undead servants.

spells.name: Unmaking Ray
spells.base_description: A thin green ray reduces its target to dust.

spells.name: Ruin
spells.base_description: A creature is wracked by a wave of virulent disease.

spells.name: Deathpoint
spells.base_description: Your finger points, and dark energy rips away life.

spells.name: Deathword
spells.base_description: A single word ends a creature's life.

spells.name: Melting Touch
spells.base_description: Your touch makes flesh and armor slough away. it burns your hand as well

spells.name: Plague Cloud
spells.base_description: A choking green cloud rolls over the land and kills what breathes it. wind can turn it back on you

spells.name: Death Sting
spells.base_description: A single sting stops the heart. you must touch the target

spells.name: Hushdome
spells.base_description: A dome of total silence swallows all sound within it.

spells.name: Hedge Trick
spells.base_description: Small, harmless wonders bloom at your fingertips: sparks, scents, chills, and tidied dust.

spells.name: Dawnfall
spells.base_description: Pure radiance pours down on a foe like the first light breaking through the clouds.

spells.name: Wisplights
spells.base_description: Tiny floating lanterns of soft light bob and drift wherever you guide them.

spells.name: Steady Hand
spells.base_description: A gentle touch steadies an ally's focus just when they need it most.

spells.name: Phantom Grasp
spells.base_description: A faint spectral hand appears to lift, pull, and carry things at your direction.

spells.name: Starlance
spells.base_description: A flash of starlight streaks toward a foe and leaves it glowing for your allies.

spells.name: Infernal Retort
spells.base_description: When struck, you answer with a burst of infernal flame that engulfs your attacker.

spells.name: Seamknit
spells.base_description: Broken things knit back together under your touch, leaving no scar or seam.

spells.name: Windborne Word
spells.base_description: Your whisper rides the air to a distant ear, and their reply finds its way back to you.

spells.name: Spark Grip
spells.base_description: Lightning crackles across your hand and jolts whoever you touch.

spells.name: Cinder Dart
spells.base_description: A mote of fire leaps from your fingertip and bursts against your target.

spells.name: Warm Hands
spells.base_description: Your touch closes wounds and eases pain with soft, warm light.

spells.name: Kind Word
spells.base_description: A single kind word mends an ally's wounds from across the battlefield.

spells.name: Rallying Hymn
spells.base_description: Your voice rings out and mends the wounds of many allies at once.

spells.name: Tide of Mending
spells.base_description: Healing light washes over many allies at once.

spells.name: Lifebloom
spells.base_description: A surge of healing energy restores a creature's vitality.

spells.name: Great Mending
spells.base_description: Healing energy restores many creatures at once.

spells.name: Grand Feast
spells.base_description: A magical feast fortifies all who share it.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.base_description: A phantom tide surges around a creature. It must make a Might roll or be dragged toward you.
